items.reason: A gentle peptide cream that suits starting a smoothing, firming routine early, and it can double as your moisturizer.
The retinal eye cream you asked for, used at night in a low strength to support the look of firmness around the eyes.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside a retinal product and is the most useful anti-aging step at any age.

response.routine_note: In the morning, apply the SPF as your last step, and at night, apply the peptide cream, starting the retinal eye cream on 2 nights a week and building up as your skin feels comfortable. Keep the retinal product to the eye area, and avoid layering other strong actives while you start.
